sentences.en: Good evening everyone.
sentences.zh: 晚上好，各位。

sentences.en: My name's Phil Sutton, and I'm chairman of the Highways Committee.
sentences.zh: 我叫菲尔·萨顿，是公路委员会主席。

sentences.en: We've called this meeting to inform members of the public about the new regulations for traffic and parking we're proposing for Granford.
sentences.zh: 我们召开此次会议，旨在向公众通报我们为格兰福德镇拟定的交通与停车新规定。

sentences.en: I'll start by summarising these changes before we open the meeting to questions.
sentences.zh: 我将先简要概述这些变更，然后开放会议接受提问。

sentences.en: So, why do we need to make these changes to traffic systems in Granford?
sentences.zh: 那么，我们为何需要对格兰福德镇的交通系统做出这些调整呢？

sentences.en: Well, we're very aware that traffic is becoming an increasing problem.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们非常清楚交通问题正日益加剧。

sentences.en: It's been especially noticeable with the increase in heavy traffic while they've been building the new hospital.
sentences.zh: 尤其是在新建医院施工期间，重型车辆增多，这一现象尤为明显。

sentences.en: But it's the overall rise in the volume of traffic of all kinds that's concerning us.
sentences.zh: 但真正令我们担忧的是各类车辆总体流量的持续上升。

sentences.en: To date there's not been any increase in traffic accidents, but that's not something we want to see happen, obviously.
sentences.zh: 截至目前，交通事故数量尚未增加，但显然，这是我们绝不愿看到的情况。

sentences.en: We recently carried out a survey of local residents, and their responses were interesting.
sentences.zh: 我们近期对当地居民开展了一项调查，其反馈结果颇有趣味。

sentences.en: People were very concerned about the lack of visibility on some roads due to cars parked.
sentences.zh: 民众普遍担忧部分道路因路边停放车辆而导致视线受阻。

sentences.en: along the sides of the roads.
sentences.zh: 沿道路两侧停放的车辆。

sentences.en: We'd expected complaints about the congestion near the school when parents are dropping off their children or picking them up, but this wasn't top of the list, and nor were noise and fumes from trucks and lorries, though they were mentioned by some people.
sentences.zh: 我们原本预计家长接送孩子上下学时学校周边拥堵问题会成为投诉焦点，但该问题并未排在首位；卡车和货车产生的噪音与尾气污染虽被部分居民提及，但也未位列前茅。

sentences.en: We think these new traffic regulations would make a lot of difference.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，这些新的交通规定将产生显著改善效果。

sentences.en: But we still have a long way to go.
sentences.zh: 但我们的工作仍任重道远。

sentences.en: We've managed to keep our proposals within budget, just, so they can be covered by the Council.
sentences.zh: 我们勉强将提案控制在预算范围内，因此可由市议会全额承担。

sentences.en: But. of course, it's no good introducing new regulations if we don't have a way of making sure that everyone obeys them, and that's an area we're still working on with the help of representatives from the police force.
sentences.zh: 然而，若缺乏行之有效的监管手段以确保所有人遵守新规，则推行新规毫无意义——目前我们正联合警方代表，在这一领域持续开展工作。

sentences.en: OK, so this slide shows a map of the central area of Granford, with the High Street in the middle and School Road on the right.
sentences.zh: 好的，这张幻灯片展示了格兰福德镇中心区域的地图，其中主街位于中央，学校路位于右侧。

sentences.en: Now, we already have a set of traffic lights in the High.
sentences.zh: 目前，主街上已设有交通信号灯。

sentences.en: Street at the junction with Station Road, but we're planning to have another set at the other.
sentences.zh: 街道与车站路交汇处，但我们计划在另一端也设置一组。

sentences.en: end, at the School Road junction, to regulate the flow of traffic along the High Street.
sentences.zh: 另一端位于学校路交汇处，以调节高街沿线的交通流量。

sentences.en: We've decided we definitely need a pedestrian crossing.
sentences.zh: 我们已确定必须设置人行横道。

sentences.en: We considered putting this on School Road, just outside the school, but in the end we decided that could lead to a lot of traffic congestion sO we decided to locate it on the High Street, crossing the road in front of the supermarket.
sentences.zh: 我们曾考虑将人行横道设在学校路、学校正门外，但最终决定这可能导致严重交通拥堵，因此决定将其设在高街上，横跨超市正前方的道路。

sentences.en: That's a very busy area, so it should help things there.
sentences.zh: 该区域非常繁忙，因此此举应有助于缓解此处的交通状况。

sentences.en: We're proposing some changes to parking.
sentences.zh: 我们拟对停车规定进行一些调整。

sentences.en: At present, parking isn't allowed on the High.
sentences.zh: 目前，图书馆外的高街上禁止停车。

sentences.en: Street outside the library, but we're going to change that, and allow parking there, but not at the other end of the High Street near School Road.
sentences.zh: 但我们将对此作出调整，允许在此处停车，而高街靠近学校路的另一端则不允许停车。

sentences.en: There'll be a new 'No Parking' sign on School Road, just by the entrance to the school, forbidding parking for 25 metres.
sentences.zh: 学校路将新增一块‘禁止停车’标志牌，位置就在学校入口旁，禁止停车范围为25米。

sentences.en: This should improve visibility for drivers and pedestrians, especially on the bend just to the north of the school.
sentences.zh: 此举应能提升司机和行人的视线可见度，尤其是学校北侧弯道处。

sentences.en: As far as disabled drivers are concerned, at present they have parking outside the supermarket, but lorries also use those spaces, so we've got two new disabled parking.
sentences.zh: 关于残障驾驶员，目前他们可在超市外停车，但货车也占用这些车位，因此我们已在通往银行的支路上增设两个新的残障专用车位。

sentences.en: spaces on the side road up towards the bank.
sentences.zh: 支路上通往银行一侧新增了两个残障专用车位。

sentences.en: It's not ideal, but probably better than the present arrangement.
sentences.zh: 这并非理想方案，但可能比当前安排更优。

sentences.en: We also plan to widen the pavement on School Road.
sentences.zh: 我们还计划拓宽学校路的人行道。

sentences.en: We think we can manage to get an extra half-metre on the bend just before you get to the school, on the same side of the road.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，在抵达学校前的弯道处、道路同一侧，可额外增加半米宽的人行道。

sentences.en: Finally, we've introduced new restrictions on loading and unloading for the supermarket, so lorries will only be allowed to stop there before 8 am.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们对超市的装卸货实施了新限制：货车仅允许在上午8点前停靠。

sentences.en: That's the supermarket on School Road we kept to the existing arrangements with the High Street supermarket.
sentences.zh: 此处所指为学校路上的超市；高街上的超市则维持现有安排。

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So that's about it.
sentences.zh: 大致情况就这些。

sentences.en: Now, would anyone
sentences.zh: 那么，各位有什么问题吗？
